Solidity.Roadmap.V16.dispatch_selected_s.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {Γ : Solidity.Ctx} (pre : List (Solidity.DispatchArm C Γ)) (a : Solidity.DispatchArm C Γ)
  (post : List (Solidity.DispatchArm C Γ)) (fail : Solidity.Stmt C Γ Γ) (σ : Solidity.State C Γ),
  (∀ (b : Solidity.DispatchArm C Γ), b ∈ pre → Solidity.Val.evalT σ b.cond = Except.ok false) →
    Solidity.Val.evalT σ a.cond = Except.ok true →
      Solidity.Stmt.run σ (Solidity.DispatchArm.chain (pre ++ a :: post) fail) =
        Solidity.Stmt.run σ (Solidity.Stmt.block a.body)

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.dispatch_finite_dia.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {Γ : Solidity.Ctx} {b L frame : Nat} {F : Solidity.Evm.Frag Γ}
  (pre : List (Solidity.DispatchArm C Γ)) (a : Solidity.DispatchArm C Γ) (post : List (Solidity.DispatchArm C Γ))
  (fail : Solidity.Stmt C Γ Γ) (σ : Solidity.State C Γ) (φ : Solidity.Spec C Γ),
  (∀ (x : Solidity.DispatchArm C Γ), x ∈ pre → Solidity.Val.evalT σ x.cond = Except.ok false) →
    Solidity.Val.evalT σ a.cond = Except.ok true →
      ∀
        (compiled :
          Solidity.Evm.Compiler.Compilation b F
            (Solidity.Prog.cons (Solidity.DispatchArm.chain (pre ++ a :: post) fail) Solidity.Prog.nil)),
        compiled.isMemory = true ∨ compiled.isReferenceArray = true ∨ compiled.isObject = true →
          ∀ {base : Nat → Fin Solidity.Evm.W} {m : Solidity.Evm.Machine},
            compiled.Input L frame base σ m →
              Solidity.Spec.sat σ
                  (Solidity.Spec.diamond (Solidity.Prog.cons (Solidity.Stmt.block a.body) Solidity.Prog.nil) φ) →
                ∃ o m',
                  Solidity.Prog.run σ
                        (Solidity.Prog.cons (Solidity.DispatchArm.chain (pre ++ a :: post) fail) Solidity.Prog.nil) =
                      Except.ok o ∧
                    Solidity.Evm.run compiled.code m = Solidity.Evm.Out.ok m' 0 ∧
                      m'.stack = m.stack ∧ compiled.Rep L frame base σ m o.st m' ∧ Solidity.Spec.sat o.st φ

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.abi_eager_observati.type:
∀ {I : Solidity.AbiEntry.Input},
  I.size ≤ Solidity.AbiEntry.lim →
    ∀ {f : Nat} {s : Solidity.AbiEntry.Shape} {pos : Nat} {v : Solidity.AbiEntry.Val s},
      Solidity.AbiEntry.eager I (f + 1) s pos = Except.ok v →
        ∀ (Q : Solidity.AbiEntry.Val s → Prop),
          Q v →
            ∃ addr len,
              Solidity.AbiEntry.cref I s 4 pos = Except.ok (addr, len) ∧
                Solidity.AbiEntry.cval I f s addr len = Except.ok v ∧ Q v

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.abi_uint_finite_dia.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {Γ Δ : Solidity.Ctx} {b L frame : Nat} {F : Solidity.Evm.Frag Γ} {P : Solidity.Prog C Γ Δ}
  (compiled : Solidity.Evm.Compiler.Compilation b F P),
  compiled.isMemory = true ∨ compiled.isReferenceArray = true ∨ compiled.isObject = true →
    ∀ {I : Solidity.AbiEntry.Input},
      I.size ≤ Solidity.AbiEntry.lim →
        ∀ {f pos : Nat} {v : Solidity.AbiEntry.Val (Solidity.AbiEntry.Shape.word (Solidity.AbiEntry.Kind.uint 256))},
          Solidity.AbiEntry.eager I (f + 1) (Solidity.AbiEntry.Shape.word (Solidity.AbiEntry.Kind.uint 256)) pos =
              Except.ok v →
            ∀ (σ : Solidity.State C Γ) (i : Solidity.Idx Γ (Solidity.LTy.val Solidity.PrimTy.uint))
              {base : Nat → Fin Solidity.Evm.W} {m : Solidity.Evm.Machine},
              compiled.Input L frame base (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.bindAbiUint σ i v) m →
                ∀ {φ : Solidity.Spec C Δ},
                  Solidity.Spec.sat (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.bindAbiUint σ i v) (Solidity.Spec.diamond P φ) →
                    ∃ addr len o m',
                      Solidity.AbiEntry.cref I (Solidity.AbiEntry.Shape.word (Solidity.AbiEntry.Kind.uint 256)) 4 pos =
                          Except.ok (addr, len) ∧
                        Solidity.AbiEntry.cval I f (Solidity.AbiEntry.Shape.word (Solidity.AbiEntry.Kind.uint 256)) addr
                              len =
                            Except.ok v ∧
                          Solidity.Prog.run (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.bindAbiUint σ i v) P = Except.ok o ∧
                            Solidity.Evm.run compiled.code m = Solidity.Evm.Out.ok m' 0 ∧
                              m'.stack = m.stack ∧
                                compiled.Rep L frame base (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.bindAbiUint σ i v) m o.st m' ∧
                                  Solidity.Spec.sat o.st φ
